Name: Yuzu Chest
Author: Yuzu17
Description:
[color=#d4d4d8]A huge chest for your  QoL.[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]Nothing complicated !
Just use it like any other chest.[/color]

[color=#00ffff][size=4][b]Additional Features [/b][/size][/color]
[color=#00ffff][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/51306]Custom Backpack Framework for Yuzu Chest[/url][/b][/color]
Adds compatibility fixes for [i][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29382?tab=files]Pack and Backpack Collection[/url][/b][/i] when using vanilla chests or Yuzu Chest. Compatible with Automate, Chests Anywhere, and Better Sort.


[b][color=#00ffff][size=4]Installation instructions[/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*]Download and unzip Yuzu Chest.[/*]
[*]Place the folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/*]
[/list]
